name: singlet_imputation_expression_denoising
title: Expression denoising of UMI counts
description: Estimates expected expression for each cell and gene from a raw UMI count matrix and writes layers/denoised, plus layers/denoised_sd for posterior methods. The default method sanity is a model-based Poisson posterior with no user-tuned smoothing strength; magic and alra are heuristic comparators, dca and scvi are neural. Use before analyses that need expression rates. Do not use the output as counts for count-based tests or on protein counts. layers/counts is never modified.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Denoiser. sanity is the default model-based posterior; magic and alra are heuristic comparators; dca and scvi are neural.

output_scale.description: expected_counts: molecules at the input depth; cp10k: per-cell proportions times 1e4, depth removed.

sanity.description: Options for method sanity (Poisson posterior with a per-gene variance grid).

variance_estimator.description: MAP: mode of the variance-grid likelihood; EAP: its mean under a uniform grid prior.

variance_min.description: Lower bound of the variance grid.

variance_max.description: Upper bound of the variance grid; must exceed variance_min.

n_bins.description: Number of grid points for the gene variance.

magic.description: Options for method magic (diffusion over a kNN graph in PCA space).

t.description: Diffusion power; the main smoothing control.

n_pca.description: Principal components used before the kNN graph.

solver.description: Diffusion solver; approximate trades accuracy for speed.

alra.description: Options for method alra (rank-k SVD with zero-preserving thresholding).

k.description: Rank; 0 selects k automatically by the singular-value noise threshold.

q.description: Power iterations in the randomised SVD.

quantile_prob.description: Per-gene quantile setting the zeroing threshold.

dca.description: Options for method dca (autoencoder with NB or ZINB decoder).

ae_type.description: Likelihood head; the API default is nb-conddisp, not zinb.

early_stop.description: Epochs without improvement before early stopping.

scvi.description: Options for method scvi (variational autoencoder; decoded normalised expression).

use_observed_library_size.description: Use the observed library size instead of inferring it.

n_samples.description: Posterior draws averaged; above 1 writes layers/denoised_sd.

batch_key.description: obs column of batch labels used as a model covariate; null for none.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for neural training and the randomised SVD of alra.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing the result.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. layers/denoised. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, output_scale, n_cells, n_genes, zero_fraction_before, zero_fraction_after. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
